title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closes US session at 66,413 dollars, up 1.8 percent, holding ground while fear dominates at index 33. 

Daily range shows modest gains but thin volume leaves moves vulnerable. Hashrate steady near 867 EH/s and mempool fees at just 2 sat/vB despite nearly 90,000 transactions point to efficient network conditions rather than stress.

Key takeaway: price resilience meets lingering caution, with no aggressive buying yet confirmed.

Overnight focus stays on hashrate stability and any fee spik
